description.plain:
The 12" bioactive PVC mini reptile enclosure is the perfect habitat for keepers who want a compact, durable, and naturalistic environment for small reptiles and invertebrates. Designed for long-term stability, the 12" bioactive PVC mini reptile enclosure offers excellent insulation, humidity retention, and structural strength. Its small footprint makes the 12" bioactive PVC mini reptile enclosure ideal for desktops, racks, and display shelves without sacrificing functionality.

Ideal for dart frogs, small geckos, juvenile reptiles, and invertebrates, the 12" bioactive PVC mini reptile enclosure supports bioactive substrates, live plants, moss, and beneficial clean-up crews. The front-opening design of the 12" bioactive PVC mini reptile enclosure makes feeding, misting, and maintenance simple while minimizing stress for your animals. Because PVC performs exceptionally well in humid environments, the 12" bioactive PVC mini reptile enclosure is perfect for tropical and semi-humid species.

Perfect for hatchlings, small reptiles, amphibians, and invertebrates, this mini habitat holds heat and humidity effortlessly. Every enclosure is laser-cut, hand-assembled, and sealed with silicone, ensuring a leak-free, long-lasting design that arrives fully assembled and ready to use.

🔥 Premium Build Features for 12" bioactive PVC mini reptile enclosure

  • Constructed from ½" thick PVC for superior insulation

  • Ball-bearing tempered glass doors for easy sliding and long life

  • Laser-cut panels for precision and durability

  • Silicone-sealed joints to retain humidity and prevent leaks

  • Lightweight, waterproof, and chemical-resistant

  • Available in multiple widths, depths, and color finishes

🌿 Why Choose 12" bioactive PVC mini reptile enclosure

  • 75% lighter than wood yet exceptionally strong

  • Waterproof and easy to clean — perfect for bioactive setups

  • Maintains temperature and humidity with minimal fluctuation

  • Non-reflective interior reduces stress for animals

  • Resistant to warping, cracking, or chemical damage

🐍 Ideal For 12" bioactive PVC mini reptile enclosure

  • Hatchling snakes (colubrids, pythons, boas)

  • Small lizards like geckos, skinks, and anoles

  • Dart frogs, tree frogs, and other amphibians

  • Invertebrates and tarantulas

⚙️ Specifications for 12" bioactive PVC mini reptile enclosure

  • Length: 12"

  • Material: ½" PVC plastic

  • Doors: ¼" tempered or plexiglass (ball-bearing rolling)

  • Assembly: Ships fully assembled

  • Customization: Lighting, heating, venting, and door style options available

💡 Optional Add-Ons

  • Single or dual 6" screen cutouts (for heat domes 5.5" or smaller)

  • Ceiling-mounted 24" or 48" T5 HO grow lights with UVB capability

  • 11" × 16" heat tape (requires thermostat)

  • Radiant Heat Panels: 28W, 40W, 80W, or 120W

  • Vents, casters, or door customization available

📦 Production & Delivery

  • Each enclosure is built to order and subject to current lead times

  • Local pickup and delivery available in Ohio

  • Freight shipping available upon request

⚠ Safety Reminder

Always use a thermostat with heat tape or heat panels. Stumps Custom Wood is not responsible for damage caused by improper heating use.

FAQ

Q: Do these enclosures come fully assembled?
A: Yes, all 12 Series enclosures are assembled, sealed, and ready to use on arrival.

Q: Can I request specific color or lighting options?
A: Absolutely — every enclosure is custom-built. Choose from several finishes, lighting setups, and door styles.

Q: What animals fit best?
A: Perfect for hatchlings, small snakes, geckos, frogs, and invertebrates.

Q: Is PVC safe for high humidity?
A: Yes, PVC is waterproof and mold-resistant, making it ideal for bioactive and tropical environments.

Q: Do you offer other sizes?
A: Yes — check out our 18", 24", 36", and 48" Series Enclosures for larger habitats.

description.plain:
For Boxco P-Series,Ultraviolet Stabilizer is added to protect the enclosures for outdoor usage. Few colour changes will be noticed even after a long time of use. Anti-static material is used to protect sensitive electronic instruments from static electricity. It is made of high impact resistant material which is very strong against external impact and also prevents breakage during hole and press processing. Special spec can be added besides standard specification. We can supply optimized products with the spec and material you choose.

Features

  • Latch - Main part of the draw latch is made of stainless steel so it is very strong.
  • Pre-molded Mounting Screw Nuts – You can easily fix DIN RAIL or other equipment on to the pre molded Screw nuts
  • Roof Protection – Both ends of the P series are protruded to protect against penetration of water when using it outdoor and penetration of dust when opening/closing the cover
  • Gasket – The gasket in injected by super precise CNC robot machine to product excellent waterproof and dust-proof performance
  • Mounting Plate Attachment Point – Internal mounting plate can be fixed tightly onto the brass inserted injection molding to handle heavy equipment installed inside the enclosure
  • Integrated Hinge – Hinge is made of plastic and is integrated with the enclosure. Bearing is made of stainless steel to increase the life span.

description.plain:
This Breadboard enclosure is stackable, modular, extensible and hackable! Use it to quickly convert your prototype into a functional and good-looking product!

Works with any breadboard-friendly micro-controllers or single-board computers like the Arduino Nano, Adafruit Feather, Particle Argon, Raspberry Pi Pico and so on.  A microUSB/USB plug cutout makes it great to power these and the rest of your circuitry. 

This case fits a 1/2 sized breadboard, or 3 tiny/mini-sized ones. You can fit a full-sized breadboard by horizontally stacking two enclosures.

The case has an internal clearance of over 1.2 inches, which gives you ample room for components & wiring!

You can use this vanilla enclosure to house any custom board that fits its dimensions (see below).

The acrylic material & modular design make it eminently hackable. Drill cutouts or mounting holes into the side walls, top or base plate. You can modify a single side without affecting the others pieces (working with a single flat piece of acrylic is also easier). The modular design makes assembly a snap.

Extension kits and add-ons are available to add functionality to your enclosure - add , switches, ultrasonic sensor, DB9/RS232 port, micro-servo and more! Check out our extension kits and add-ons!

Features

  • Fits half-sized breadboard, or 3 tiny/mini-sized breadboards (4 if the side walls are omitted)
  • Use with any breadboard-friendly micro-controller thanks to the micro-USB/USB cutout
  • Internal clearance of over 1.2 in, which gives you ample room for components and wiring for your breadboard!
  • Made from high quality cast acrylic
  • Clear acrylic provides a beautiful finish with a modern visual design with full view of your electronics 
  • Our Obsidian black acrylic gives you a sleek and attractive option when you want to keep your brains and sinew under the covers and just highlight the peripherals
  • Metal standoffs and screws provide solid and durable support 
  • Rubber Feet protect your table surface while providing maximum airflow by elevating the enclosure
  • Cable Management: Easily accessible cable management cutouts in the side walls allow you to smoothly insert your cables & access wiring to external systems. In the Open Configuration, the Wall slots on the top and bottom plates (where the side walls usually insert into) can also be used for cable management for even more accessibility and organization.
  • You can mix, match, customize, and expand your project enclosure because ProtoStax enclosures are modular and stackable and work with each other.
  • Extension kits and add-ons help add functionality to your enclosure, such as adding switches, displays, sensor peripherals, etc.

      List of Compatible Devices

      Arduino Nano/MKR/Portenta boards like

      Arduino Nano / 33 IOT / Every / 33 BLE / Sense
      Arduino Micro

      Arduino MKR GSM 1400 / 1000 WIFI / WAN 1300 

      Arduino Portenta H7

       Feather boards like

      Adafruit HUZZAH32 – ESP32 Feather Board
      Adafruit Feather HUZZAH -ESP8266
      Adafruit Feather M0 WiFi
      Adafruit Feather 32u4 Bluefruit LE
      Adafruit Feather 32u4 RFM96 LoRa Radio
      Adafruit Feather 328P
      Adafruit Feather M0 RFM69HCW Packet Radio
      Particle Argon
      Particle Boron LTE
      Particle Xenon
      Particle Photon
      Teensy boards
      BlackBoard Artemis Nano
      SparkFun Pro Micro
      SparkFun Thing Plus
      SparkFun SAMD21 Mini Breakout
      Qduino Micro       		and more!

      Basically, any Breadboard friendly micro-controller or single board computer! 😊

description.plain:
Fits: Bambu Lab X1/P1 Series

This X1/P1 HotBox® enclosure is crafted to fit your Bambu Lab X1/P1 seamlessly. If you want to print ABS, Nylon, PC, and other high-temperature filaments, an enclosure is one of the best upgrades for your machine. The X1/P1 Series HotBox® is your solution for stable interior temperature, fume and odor control, reduced printer noise (20%), and convenient access to your Bambu Lab P1P and tools. Check out our YouTube P1P HotBox® Overview or read on to learn how the P1/X1 Series HotBox® accomplishes these 4 main properties:

The HotBox® is made of a sandwich of 3 materials selected to create structure and excellent insulating properties. The result is a lightweight semi-rigid construction, so structural that you can place a few spool holders or even the AMS on top of the unit. The exterior is made of a flame retardant, ballistic Nylon 600D, the center is a structural honeycomb polymer panel selected for its insulation properties, and the interior is a metal lining that reflects and maintains optimal temperatures (between 35-60°C) for the duration of the print. Watch our temp testing video on YouTube.

Our entire HotBox® line comes with an optional vent port where you can mount a fan to either filter or pipe the fumes out a window. An easy-to-make fume extractor, 3D models, parts lists, and instructions can be found on Cults here. A Video Short showing the build is here.

The HotBox® was able to achieve a nearly 20% reduction of noise in comparison to bare P1/X1 Series, with Bambu plastic panels, and even the X Series with their metal enclosure. See the machine noise comparison video here.

Unlike other solutions, the X1/P1 HotBox® allows you to access either side of your Bambu Lab printer easily by just unzipping the side and swinging it open. The front door allows full access to the build plate and interior. And the whole unit is removable in less than 10 seconds should you need to work on your printer.

Other great features:

  • A built-in thermometer (two LR44 batteries not included) to easily view the internal temperature.
  • The front panel has a large clear window for maximum visibility which is a fully openable door that remains fixed to the side when you need front access. No more glass breakages, no more obstructions!
  • The right side panel touts tool pouches and elastic straps to keep your most needed tools at arm's reach.
  • The rear has openings for venting, the poop chute, the power chord, and the switch.
  • A removable patch should you ever mount a rear panel with an extra CPU fan.
  • A line of printable accessories is available on cults. A custom poop bucket for use with the P1P HotBox® and an AMS buffer mount that allows you to use an upgraded buffer with the P1P HotBox®.

Protect your home and workspace from fire with the Cloud® - Personal Printer Sentry.

View the entire HotBox® line and accessories.

Printer Fits:
  • Bambu Lab X1 Series
  • Bambu LAB P1 Series
Includes: 1 X1/P1 Series HotBox®

Included features:
  • Lightweight semi-rigid construction
  • Excellent insulating properties
  • 3 cable exits, one each on the left, right, and back panels
  • Large opening for front access with transparent front window
  • Side zippers allow for full access when needed
  • 2 large spool holder access ports with repositionable covers
  • Front-mounted thermometer (two LR44 batteries not included)
  • Passage with cover for user-added aspiration and air filtering
  • Folds up flat, is easy to store and transport
  • 2 sets of loops to hold a LED light bar
  • Add a Laser and UV-safe window upgrade to your HotBox® and protect yourself when using your laser attachment or printing and curing resin.
  • Brighten your HotBox®! This HotBox® has loops to add two LED lights inside.
  • Protect your home and workspace from fire with the Cloud® - Personal Printer Sentry.

See our HotBox® Support Page.

Build instructions:
Video Install of the P1P HotBox®

  1. Unpack all components from the enclosure’s box, ensuring all parts are included.
  2. Remove your HotBox® from its packaging, unfold, and lay flat with the metallic side upward.
  3. Locate the small rectangular rear of the thermometer. Push the cover in the direction of the arrow and swing it upward. You will need to purchase 2 LR44 Batteries (also listed as A76 or 357) and Insert 2 LR44 batteries with the + side up (large smooth side). Push each down so it clicks in. Now swing down the cover and slide it in the other direction to close.


Poop Bucket for P1P HotBox®

AMS Buffer Mount For P1P HotBox®

Grommet To Create Pass Through Hole

DIY HotBox® Exhaust Fan

Bambu Lab P1P Fumes Extraction Unit (From Wainlux) Adapter

To see the HotBox® in action, please check out our HotBox® YouTube Playlist.

  • Adding a Hole and Grommet to a Wham Bam HotBox®
  • Temperature Testing our Bambu Lab P1P Enclosure
  • Noise Testing Bambu Lab Machines vs P1P HotBox®
  • Print and assemble this DIY Exhaust Fan to use on any FDM or Resin version

• Description


The Altelix NP120907A1C NEMA 4X enclosure is simple to install because no wiring is required. Simply mount the enclosure and plug the pre-wired 5 foot power cord into a nearby outlet. Two internal pre-wired 120VAC power outlets are provided to power your equipment.

Polycarbonate + ABS Protection Built to Last
This enclosure is molded out of UV resistant Polycarbonate + ABS, an industrial grade plastic with greater strength and durability than standard ABS. This enclosure can be easily drilled and modified by the installer to suit unique site requirements It meets or exceeds NEMA 1, 2, 4, 4X, 12, 13 and IEC 529 IP65, IP66.



Power
This configuration consists of the PC+ABS NEMA enclosure with hinged lid and a 120VAC power outlet. A 5 foot pre-wired power cord is included to power the enclosure, so no additional wiring is required. A cable grommet on the enclosure allows cables to be connected to internal devices. Knock-outs are also provided on the enclosure for additional wiring. Extra cable grommets are included with the accessory kit.

Complete with Cable Grommets and Wire Management Accessories
This enclosure includes an assortment of cable grommets and cable glands that can be installed in the knock-out holes for a weather resistant seal. Also included in the accessory kit are wall anchors, zip ties, wire management loops, hook-n-loop tape, ground wire, (2) door locking keys and more.

description.plain:
This Arduino Uno & Mega case is stackable, modular, extensible and hackable! 

It fits both Uno/Leonardo AND Mega footprints, and can accommodate any boards that have an Arduino footprint like SparkFun RedBoard, BlackBoard Artemis, etc. (see list of compatible devices below).

As of August 10th, 2026, it also fits the new Arduino Uno Q! It has cutouts on the base plate to accommodate the new headers on the bottom of the board, and a cutout on the side plate to match the reset button (also found on the Arduino Uno Rev 4. Any new boards you purchase now will include support for UNO Rev 4 and UNO Q!

The case has an internal clearance of over 1.2 inches, which gives you ample room to install a shield (or two) of your choice!

Extension kits and add-ons are available to add functionality to your enclosure - add , switches, ultrasonic sensor, DB9/RS232 port, micro-servo and more! Check out our extension kits and add-ons!

Features

  • Fits both Uno/Leonardo AND Mega footprints!
  • New! Fits UNO Q with cutouts on the base plate to accommodate bottom headers!
  • Internal clearance of over 1.2 inches, which gives you ample room for a shield (or even two!)
  • Made from high quality cast acrylic
  • Clear acrylic provides a beautiful finish with a modern visual design with full view of your electronics
  • Our Obsidian black acrylic gives you a sleek and attractive option when you want to keep your brains and sinew under the covers and just highlight the peripherals
  • Pre-drilled and threaded mounting holes in the base plate allow you to directly screw the board in without needing additional nuts, making it very easy and elegant for you to use. A thoughtful feature that you will surely appreciate if you have larger hands and dealing with tiny M2.5 nuts!  
  • Acrylic risers raise your board off the base plate for improved airflow and firm level mounting
  • Metal standoffs and screws provide solid and durable support 
  • Rubber Feet protect your table surface while providing maximum airflow by elevating the enclosure
  • Cutouts leave USB and power ports accessible 
  • Cable Management: Easily accessible cable management cutouts in the side walls allow you to smoothly insert your cables and access wiring to external systems. In the Open Configuration, the Wall slots on the top and bottom plates (where the side walls usually insert into) can also be used for cable management for even more accessibility and organization.
  • You can mix, match, customize, and expand your project enclosure because ProtoStax enclosures are modular and stackable and work with each other. 
  • Extension kits and add-ons help add functionality to your enclosure, such as adding switches, displays, sensor peripherals, etc.
